description: Synthetic Postyard records. The smoke fixture is small. Evaluation history for 2025-01-01 through 2026-12-31 lives in examples/task-data/rejected-pr and examples/dataset/later-2026. Every record is synthetic. There is no real Postyard site to anchor November 2026.

sources.description: Hand-authored synthetic people, posts and notes. No external collection.

transformations: Timestamps are America/Los_Angeles offsets. Record bodies are unique aside from ids.

review.notes: Automated checks do not replace human review of realism. The smoke fixture count is 1. The evaluation partitions are reported by scripts/coverage.cjs.
